correctness.rationale: The F2 square-map from m/m² to m² has kernel dimension 1 for A and 0 for B. Explicit generator-image normal forms give 32 automorphisms each. The index-two elementary abelian subgroups have involutions represented by conjugation (u,v,s,r)↦(u,v,s+u,r+v) and C↦PCP, intertwined by an explicit invertible F2-linear Psi. Checking the 3 possible degree-2 monomial survivors yields exactly two classes at Hilbert (1,2,2); dimension-4 candidates have automorphism orders 8 and 24. Independent bit-vector automorphism enumeration reproduced orders 32,32,8,24 and square-map kernels; source checker additionally checks all 1024 group-law pairs.
residual_risks: The comparison is between abstract finite F2-rational automorphism groups, not group schemes, actions on filtered algebras, or characteristic-zero reconstruction.
Minimality is strictly within two-generated monomial local algebras at fixed Hilbert function.

value.rationale: The minimal-dimensional concrete failure of classification by a natural finite algebra automorphism group is structurally informative, sharply delimits characteristic-zero reconstruction and is supported by an explicit group isomorphism.

final_claim: The two specified F2 monomial local algebras A=F2[x,y]/(x²,xy²,y³) and B=F2[x,y]/(xy,x³,y³) are nonisomorphic with Hilbert function (1,2,2), but Aut_F2(A)≅Aut_F2(B)≅(C2)^4⋊C2 of order 32; they exhaust this Hilbert class up to variable exchange and give the least dimension of a pair among two-generated monomial algebras at fixed Hilbert data.
